verses.geez: ወአንበበት፡ ዮዲት፡ በዛቲ፡ ስብሐት፡ በኀበ፡ ኵሉ፡ እስራኤል፡ ወአውሥኡ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሕዝብ፡ በዛቲ፡ ስብሐት።
verses.translation: Then Judith began to sing this thanksgiving in all Israel, and all the people sang after her this song of praise.

translations.lxx: Then Judith began to sing this thanksgiving in all Israel, and all the people sang after her this song of praise.
translations.ron: Şi Iudita a zis: "Lăudaţi pe Dumnezeul meu, în tobe, cântaţi Domnului cu chimvale, uniţi pentru El psalmul cu cântarea, preaslăviţi şi chemaţi numele Lui!
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξῆρχεν Ἰουδὶθ τὴν ἐξομολόγησιν ταύτην ἐν παντὶ Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ὑπεφώνει πᾶς ὁ λαὸς τὴν αἴνεσιν ταύτην·

verses.geez: ወትቤ፡ ዮዲት፡ ሰብሕዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ አምላክነ፡ በከበሮ፡ ወኀልዩ፡ በጸናጽል፡ ወሰንቅዉ፡ ሎቱ፡ በመዝሙር፡ ወበስብሐት፡ አልዕልዎ፡ ወፀውዑ፡ ስሞ።
verses.translation: And Judith said, Begin unto my God with timbrels, sing unto my Lord with cymbals: tune unto him a new psalm: exalt him, and call upon his name.

translations.lxx: And Judith said, Begin unto my God with timbrels, sing unto my Lord with cymbals: tune unto him a new psalm: exalt him, and call upon his name.
translations.ron: Dumnezeu, Cel care pune capăt războaielor, este Domnul, căci, în tabără şi în mijlocul poporului, El m-a scăpat din mâna celui ce mă urmărea pe mine.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν Ἰουδὶθ, Ἐξάρχετε τῷ Θεῷ μου ἐν τυμπάνοις, ᾄσατε τῷ Κυρίῳ μου ἐν κυμβάλοις, ἐναρμόσασθε αὐτῷ ψαλμὸν καινὸν, ὑψοῦτε καὶ ἐπικαλέσασθε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይቀጠቅጥ፡ ፀብዐ፡ ወእግዚአብሔር፡ ስሙ።
verses.translation: For God breaketh the battles: for among the camps in the midst of the people he hath delivered me out of the hands of them that persecuted me.

translations.lxx: For God breaketh the battles: for among the camps in the midst of the people he hath delivered me out of the hands of them that persecuted me.
translations.ron: Venit-a Asur din munţii de la miazănoapte; el a venit cu zecile de mii ale oştirii sale, şi mulţimea lor stăvilea puhoaiele şi caii lor acopereau văile.
translations.grk: ὅτι Θεὸς συντρίβων πολέμους Κύριος, ὅτι εἰς παρεμβολὰς αὐτοῦ ἐν μέσῳ λαοῦ ἐξείλατό με ἐκ χειρὸς τῶν καταδιωκόντων με.

verses.geez: ወትዕይንቱ፡ ማዕከለ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ወአድኃነነ፡ እምእለ፡ ዴገኑነ።
verses.translation: Assur came out of the mountains from the north, he came with ten thousands of his army, the multitude whereof stopped the torrents, and their horsemen have covered the hills.

translations.lxx: Assur came out of the mountains from the north, he came with ten thousands of his army, the multitude whereof stopped the torrents, and their horsemen have covered the hills.
translations.ron: Şi îşi făcea socoteală să pârjolească plaiurile mele şi pe flăcăii mei să-i treacă prin ascuţişul sabiei, pe pruncii mei să-i arunce pământului, pe copiii mei să-i dea jafului şi pe fecioarele mele răpirii.
translations.grk: Ἦλθεν Ἀσσοὺρ ἐξ ὀρέων ἀπὸ βοῤῥᾶ, ἦλθεν ἐν μυριάσι δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ, ὧν τὸ πλῆθος αὐτῶν ἐνέφραξε χειμάῤῥους, καὶ ἡ ἵππος αὐτῶν ἐκάλυψε βουνούς.

verses.geez: ወመጽኡ፡ አሶር፡ እምአድባር፡ ዘመንገለ፡ መስዕ፡ ወወጽኡ፡ በአዕላፍ፡ ኃይሎሙ፡ ወአፀዉ፡ አፍላገ፡ በበዝኆሙ፡ ወከደኑ፡ አውግረ፡ በእግረ፡ አፍራሲሆሙ።
verses.translation: He bragged that he would burn up my borders, and kill my young men with the sword, and dash the sucking children against the ground, and make mine infants as a prey, and my virgins as a spoil.

translations.lxx: He bragged that he would burn up my borders, and kill my young men with the sword, and dash the sucking children against the ground, and make mine infants as a prey, and my virgins as a spoil.
translations.ron: Domnul cel Atotputernic prin mâna unei femei i-a nimicit,
translations.grk: Εἶπεν ἐμπρήσειν τὰ ὅριά μου, καὶ τοὺς νεανίσκους μου ἀνελεῖν ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ, καὶ τὰ θηλάζοντά μου θήσειν εἰς ἔδαφος, καὶ τὰ νήπιά μου δώσειν εἰς προνομὴν, καὶ τὰς παρθένους μου σκυλεῦσαι.

verses.geez: ወይቤሉ፡ ያውዕዩ፡ ደወለነ፡ በእሳት፡ ወይቀትሉ፡ በኵናት፡ ወራዙቲነ፡ ወይፄውዉ፡ ደቂቀነ፡ ወይማህርኩ፡ ደናግሊነ።
verses.translation: But the Almighty Lord hath disappointed them by the hand of a woman.

translations.lxx: But the Almighty Lord hath disappointed them by the hand of a woman.
translations.ron: Căci Olofern al lor n-a fost doborât de tineri voinici, şi nici feciorii uriaşilor nu l-au lovit pe el, şi nici nu i-au stat împotrivă oameni înalţi ca munţii, ci Iudita, fiica lui Merari, l-a dezarmat cu frumuseţea feţei ei.
translations.grk: Κύριος Παντοκράτωρ ἠθέτησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν χειρὶ θηλείας.

verses.geez: ወእግዚአብሔር፡ ዘኵሎ፡ ይመልክ፡ ቀተሎሙ፡ በእደ፡ ብእሲት።
verses.translation: For the mighty one did not fall by the young men, neither did the sons of the Titans smite him, nor high giants set upon him: but Judith the daughter of Merari weakened him with the beauty of her countenance.

translations.lxx: For the mighty one did not fall by the young men, neither did the sons of the Titans smite him, nor high giants set upon him: but Judith the daughter of Merari weakened him with the beauty of her countenance.
translations.ron: Căci ea s-a dezbrăcat de veşmintele ei de văduvie pentru întărirea celor întristaţi ai lui Israel; ea şi-a uns faţa cu miresme,
translations.grk: Οὐ γὰρ ὑπέπεσεν ὁ δυνατὸς αὐτῶν ὑπὸ νεανίσκων, οὐδὲ υἱοὶ Τιτάνων ἐπάταξαν αὐτόν, οὐδὲ ὑψηλοὶ γίγαντες ἐπέθεντο αὐτῷ, ἀλλὰ Ἰουδὶθ θυγάτηρ Μεραρεὶ ἐν κάλλει προσώπου αὐτῆς παρέλυσεν αὐτόν.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኢወድቀ፡ ጽንኦሙ፡ በእደ፡ ወሬዛ፡ ወአኮ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ጤቤኖን፡ ዘቀተልዎሙ፡ ወአኮ፡ እለ፡ ያርብሕ፡ ዐበይት፡ ዘሞዕዎሙ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ዮዲት፡ ወለተ፡ ሜራሪ፡ በስነ፡ ገጻ፡ አድከመቶ።
verses.translation: For she put off the garment of her widowhood for the exaltation of those that were oppressed in Israel, and anointed her face with ointment, and bound her hair in a tire, and took a linen garment to deceive him.

translations.lxx: For she put off the garment of her widowhood for the exaltation of those that were oppressed in Israel, and anointed her face with ointment, and bound her hair in a tire, and took a linen garment to deceive him.
translations.ron: Şi-a prins pârul sub turban şi s-a îmbrăcat cu veşmânt de în, ca să-l ademenească.
translations.grk: Ἐξεδύσατο γὰρ στολὴν χηρεύσεως αὐτῆς εἰς ὕψος τῶν πονούντων ἐν Ἰσραήλ, ἠλείψατο τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῆς ἐν μυρισμῷ, καὶ ἐδήσατο τὰς τρίχας αὐτῆς ἐν μίτρᾳ, καὶ ἔλαβε στολὴν λινῆν εἰς ἀπάτην αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወኀደገት፡ አልባሰ፡ መበለታ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ለእለ፡ የሐምሙ፡ በውስተ፡ እስራኤል።
verses.translation: Her sandals ravished his eyes, her beauty took his mind prisoner, and the fauchion passed through his neck.

translations.lxx: Her sandals ravished his eyes, her beauty took his mind prisoner, and the fauchion passed through his neck.
translations.ron: Cu sandalele ei i-a luat ochii, frumuseţea ei i-a robit inima, şi cu sabia i-a retezat capul.
translations.grk: Τὸ σανδάλιον αὐτῆς ἥρπασεν ὀφθαλμὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ κάλλος αὐτῆς ᾐχμαλώτισε ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ· διῆλθεν ὁ ἀκινάκης τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወተቀብዐት፡ ገጻ፡ ዕፍረተ፡ ወተጸፍረት፡ ርእሳ፡ ወተከፍለት፡ ወለብሰት፡ አልባሰ፡ አግያት፡ ለአስሕቶቱ፡ ወተስእነት፡ አሣዕኒሃ።
verses.translation: The Persians quaked at her boldness, and the Medes were daunted at her hardiness.

translations.lxx: The Persians quaked at her boldness, and the Medes were daunted at her hardiness.
translations.ron: Perşii s-au îngrozit de îndrăzneala ei şi Mezii de cutezanţa ei.
translations.grk: Ἔφριξαν Πέρσαι τὴν τόλμαν αὐτῆς, καὶ Μῆδοι τὸ θράσος αὐτῆς ἐῤῥάχθησαν.

verses.geez: ወበስና፡ ተሐይዳ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ ወላሕያ፡ ፄወዋ፡ ለነፍሱ፡ ሐለፈ፡ ሰይፍ፡ እንተ፡ ክሳዱ።
verses.translation: Then my afflicted shouted for joy, and my weak ones cried aloud; but they were astonished: these lifted up their voices, but they were overthrown.

translations.lxx: Then my afflicted shouted for joy, and my weak ones cried aloud; but they were astonished: these lifted up their voices, but they were overthrown.
translations.ron: Atunci au chiuit umiliţii mei şi au strigat din răsputeri cei fără vlagă, iar ei s-au înspăimântat şi şi-au ridicat glasul şi au luat-o la goană.
translations.grk: Τότε ἠλάλαξαν οἱ ταπεινοί μου, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν οἱ ἀσθενοῦντές μου, καὶ ἐπτοήθησαν· ὕψωσαν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἀνετράπησαν.

verses.geez: ወደንገፁ፡ ፋርስ፡ እምተሀብሎታ፡ ወፈርሑ፡ ሜዶን፡ እምነ፡ ትብዓ።
verses.translation: The sons of the damsels have pierced them through, and wounded them as fugitives' children: they perished by the battle of my Lord.

translations.lxx: The sons of the damsels have pierced them through, and wounded them as fugitives' children: they perished by the battle of my Lord.
translations.ron: Copii de mame tinere i-au străpuns cu sabia şi ca pe nişte robi i-au doborât la pământ; pierit-au în bătălia Domnului meu.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ κορασίων κατεκέντησαν αὐτοὺς, καὶ ὡς παῖδας αὐτομολούντων ἐτίτρωσκον αὐτούς· ἀπώλοντο ἐκ παρατάξεως Κυρίου μου.

verses.geez: ወውእተ፡ ጊዜ፡ ወውዑ፡ ሕሙማንየ፡ ወፈርሑ፡ ድውያንየ፡ ወደንገፁ፡ ወዐልዓሉ፡ ቃሎሙ።
verses.translation: I will sing unto my God a new song: O Lord, thou art great and glorious, wonderful in strength, and invincible.

translations.lxx: I will sing unto my God a new song: O Lord, thou art great and glorious, wonderful in strength, and invincible.
translations.ron: Cânta-voi Dumnezeului meu cântare nouă: Doamne, mare eşti Tu şi preaslăvit, minunat în puterea Ta, şi nimeni nu poate să Te întreacă!
translations.grk: Ὑμνήσω τῷ Θεῷ μου ὕμνον καινόν· Κύριε, μέγας εἶ, καὶ ἔνδοξος, θαυμαστὸς ἐν ἰσχύϊ, ἀνυπέρβλητος.

verses.geez: ወዴገንዎሙ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አዋልድየ፡ ወወግዕዎሙ፡ ወወራዙቶሙኒ፡ ተደራበይዎሙ፡ ወጠፍኡ፡ እምፀባዒተ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Let all creatures serve thee: for thou spakest, and they were made: thou didst send forth thy spirit, and it created them, and there is none that can resist thy voice.

translations.lxx: Let all creatures serve thee: for thou spakest, and they were made: thou didst send forth thy spirit, and it created them, and there is none that can resist thy voice.
translations.ron: Ţie să-ţi slujească întreaga făptură, pentru că Tu ai zis şi toate s-au făcut. Trimis-ai Duhul Tău şi totul a fost zidit şi nimeni nu poate să stea împotriva poruncii Tale!
translations.grk: Σοὶ δουλευσάτω πᾶσα ἡ κτίσις σου, ὅτι εἶπας, καὶ ἐγενήθησαν· ἀπέστειλας τὸ πνεῦμά σου, καὶ ᾠκοδόμησε· καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὃς ἀντιστήσεται τῇ φωνῇ σου.

verses.geez: አነብብ፡ ስብሐተ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ አነብብ፡ ስብሐተ፡ ሐዲሰ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: For the mountains shall be moved from their foundations with the waters, the rocks shall melt as wax at thy presence: yet thou art merciful to them that fear thee.

translations.lxx: For the mountains shall be moved from their foundations with the waters, the rocks shall melt as wax at thy presence: yet thou art merciful to them that fear thee.
translations.ron: Munţii ca şi mările se zbuciumă din temelie, stâncile se topesc cum se topeşte ceara înaintea feţei Tale, iar cucei ce Te cinstesc pe Tine, milostiv eşti Tu cu ei!
translations.grk: Ὄρη γὰρ ἐκ θεμελίων σὺν ὕδασι σαλευθήσεται, πέτραι δὲ ἀπὸ προσώπου σου ὡς κηρὸς τακήσονται, ἐπὶ δὲ τοῖς φοβουμένοις σε, σὺ εὐιλατεύεις αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: እግዚአብሔርሰ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወክቡር፡ ፈድፋደ፡ ወመድምም፡ ኃይሉ።
verses.translation: For all sacrifice is too little for a sweet savour unto thee, and all the fat is not sufficient for thy burnt offering: but he that feareth the Lord is great at all times.

translations.lxx: For all sacrifice is too little for a sweet savour unto thee, and all the fat is not sufficient for thy burnt offering: but he that feareth the Lord is great at all times.
translations.ron: Fiindcă orice jertfă cu miros de mireasmă preţuieşte puţin pentru Tine şi toată grăsimea arderii de tot este şi de mai puţin preţ, însă cel ce se teme de Domnul totdeauna este mare.
translations.grk: Ὅτι μικρὸν πᾶσα θυσία εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας, καὶ ἐλάχιστον πᾶν στέαρ εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμά σοι· ὁ δὲ φοβούμενος τὸν Κύριον, μέγας διαπαντός.

verses.geez: ለከ፡ ይገንዩ፡ ኵሉ፡ ተግባርከ፡ እስመ፡ ትቤ፡ ወኮኑ፡ ወፈኖከ፡ መንፈሰከ፡ ወተሐንፁ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘኢይትኤዘዝ፡ በቃልከ።
verses.translation: Woe to the nations that rise up against my kindred! the Lord Almighty will take vengeance of them in the day of judgment, in putting fire and worms in their flesh; and they shall feel them, and weep for ever.

translations.lxx: Woe to the nations that rise up against my kindred! the Lord Almighty will take vengeance of them in the day of judgment, in putting fire and worms in their flesh; and they shall feel them, and weep for ever.
translations.ron: Vai de neamurile care se ridică împotriva poporului meu, căci Domnul cel Atotputernic le va pedepsi în ziua judecăţii, şi va da pradă trupul lor focului şi viermilor, ca să urle de durere în veci de veci!"
translations.grk: Οὐαὶ ἔθνεσιν ἐπανισταμένοις τῷ γένει μου· Κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἐκδικήσει αὐτοὺς ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κρίσεως, δοῦναι πῦρ καὶ σκώληκας εἰς σάρκας αὐτῶν, καὶ κλαύσονται ἐν αἰσθήσει ἕως αἰῶνος.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አድባርኒ፡ መሠረቶሙ፡ ይትከወሱ፡ ወይትከወሱ፡ ሰማያትኒ፡ ወኰኵሕኒ፡ ከመ፡ መዓረ፡ ግራ፡ ይትመሰው፡ እምቅድመ፡ ገጽከ፡ ወዓዲ፡ ተሠሃሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ይፈርሁከ።
verses.translation: Now as soon as they entered into Jerusalem, they worshipped the Lord; and as soon as the people were purified, they offered their burnt offerings, and their free offerings, and their gifts.

translations.lxx: Now as soon as they entered into Jerusalem, they worshipped the Lord; and as soon as the people were purified, they offered their burnt offerings, and their free offerings, and their gifts.
translations.ron: Şi când a ajuns la Ierusalim, toţi s-au închinat lui Dumnezeu, iar după ce poporul s-a curăţit, a adus arderi de tot, prinoasele lor de bună voie şi darurile lor.
translations.grk: Ὡς δὲ ἤλθοσαν εἰς Ἱερουσαλήμ, προσεκύνησαν τῷ Θεῷ· καὶ ἡνίκα ἐκαθαρίσθη ὁ λαὸς, ἀνήνεγκαν τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα αὐτῶν, καὶ τὰ ἑκουσία αὐτῶν, καὶ τὰ δόματα.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኢየአክል፡ ኵሉ፡ መሥዋዕት፡ ለመዓዛ፡ ሠናይ፡ ወይውህድ፡ ኵሉ፡ ስብሕ፡ እምነ፡ ቊርባንከ፡ ዘሰ፡ ይፈርሆ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ዓቢይ፡ ውእቱ፡ በኵሉ፡ ጊዜ።
verses.translation: Judith also dedicated all the stuff of Holofernes, which the people had given her, and gave the canopy which she had taken out of his bedchamber, for a gift unto God.

translations.lxx: Judith also dedicated all the stuff of Holofernes, which the people had given her, and gave the canopy which she had taken out of his bedchamber, for a gift unto God.
translations.ron: Şi Iudita a afierosit lui Dumnezeu ca dar, toate lucrurile lui Olofern, câte i le dăduse poporul, precum şi perdeaua pe care ea o ridicase de la patul lui, a dat-o ca afierosire pentru Domnul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέθηκεν Ἰουδὶθ πάντα τὰ σκεύη Ὀλοφέρνου ὅσα ἔδωκεν ὁ λαὸς αὐτῇ, καὶ τὸ κωνωπεῖον ὃ ἔλαβεν αὕτς ἐκ τοῦ κοιτῶνος αὐτοῦ, εἰς ἀνάθημα τῷ Θεῷ ἔδωκε.

verses.geez: አሌ፡ ሎሙ፡ ለአሕዛብ፡ እለ፡ ይቀውሙ፡ ዲበ፡ ዘመድየ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘኵሎ፡ ይመልክ፡ ይትቤቀሎሙ፡ በዕለተ፡ ደይን።
verses.translation: So the people continued feasting in Jerusalem before the sanctuary for the space of three months, and Judith remained with them.

translations.lxx: So the people continued feasting in Jerusalem before the sanctuary for the space of three months, and Judith remained with them.
translations.ron: Şi poporul s-a veselit în Ierusalim trei luni, în faţa templului, şi Iudita a rămas la ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦν ὁ λαὸς εὐφραινόμενος ἐν Ἱερουσαλὴμ κατὰ πρόσωπον τῶν ἁγίων ἐπὶ μῆνας τρεῖς, καὶ Ἰουδὶθ μετʼ αὐτῶν κατέμεινε.

verses.geez: ወይፌኑ፡ እሳተ፡ ወእፄ፡ ውስተ፡ ሥጋሆሙ፡ ወይበክዩ፡ በሕማም፡ ዘለዓለም።
verses.translation: After this time every one returned to his own inheritance, and Judith went to Bethulia, and remained in her own possession, and was in her time honourable in all the country.

translations.lxx: After this time every one returned to his own inheritance, and Judith went to Bethulia, and remained in her own possession, and was in her time honourable in all the country.
translations.ron: Iar după aceste zile, fiecare s-a întors la locul său, şi Iudita s-a întors în Betulia şi şi-a petrecut viaţa la casa ei. Şi cu înaintarea în vârstă a ajuns vestită în toată ţara.
translations.grk: Μετὰ δὲ τὰς ἡμέρας ταύτας ἀνέζευξεν ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ· καὶ Ἰουδὶθ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς Βετυλούα, καὶ κατέμεινεν ἐπὶ τῆς ὑπάρξεως αὐτῆς· καὶ ἐγένετο κατὰ τὸν καιρὸν αὐτῆς ἔνδοξος ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ.

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ በጽሑ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ ሰገዱ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወሶበ፡ አንጽሑ፡ ርእሶሙ፡ ሕዝብ፡ አብዑ፡ ቁርባኖሙ፡ ወዘበፈቃዱ፡ ሀብቶሙ።
verses.translation: And many desired her, but none knew her all the days of her life, after that Manasses her husband was dead, and was gathered to his people.

translations.lxx: And many desired her, but none knew her all the days of her life, after that Manasses her husband was dead, and was gathered to his people.
translations.ron: Mulţi au cerut-o în căsătorie, dar ea n-a cunoscut bărbat în toate zilele vieţii ei, de când murise soţul ei Manase şi se adăugase la poporul lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ πολλοὶ ἐπεθύμησαν αὐτὴν, καὶ οὐκ ἔγνω ἀνὴρ αὐτὴν πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς αὐτῆς, ἀφʼ ἧς ἡμέρας ἀπέθανε Μανασσῆς ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς, καὶ προσετέθη πρὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወአንበረት፡ ዮዲት፡ ኵሎ፡ ንዋዮ፡ ለሆሎፎርኒስ፡ ዘወሀብዋ፡ ሕዝብ።
verses.translation: But she increased more and more in honour, and waxed old in her husband's house, being an hundred and five years old, and made her maid free; so she died in Bethulia: and they buried her in the cave of her husband Manasses.

translations.lxx: But she increased more and more in honour, and waxed old in her husband's house, being an hundred and five years old, and made her maid free; so she died in Bethulia: and they buried her in the cave of her husband Manasses.
translations.ron: Faima ei creştea din ce în ce mai mult, pe când ea înainta în vârstă în casa bărbatului ei. Ea a atins vârsta de o sută şi cinci ani. Şi ea a dezrobit pe roaba ei. Ea a murit în Betulia şi a fost îngropată în peştera în care se odihnea bărbatul ei Manase.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἦν προβαίνουσα μεγάλη σφόδρα· καὶ ἐγήρασεν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς ἔτη ἑκατὸν πέντε, καὶ ἀφῆκε τὴν ἅβραν αὐτῆς ἐλευθέραν, καὶ ἀπέθανεν εἰς Βετυλούα, καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὴν ἐν τῷ σπηλαίῳ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς Μανασσῆ.

verses.geez: ተፈሥሑ፡ ሕዝብ፡ በኢየሩሳሌም፡ በቅድመ፡ መቅደስ፡ ሠለስተ፡ አውራኃ፡ ወዮዲትኒ፡ ነበረት፡ ምስሌሆሙ።
verses.translation: And the house of Israel lamented her seven days: and before she died, she did distribute her goods to all them that were nearest of kindred to Manasses her husband, and to them that were the nearest of her kindred.

translations.lxx: And the house of Israel lamented her seven days: and before she died, she did distribute her goods to all them that were nearest of kindred to Manasses her husband, and to them that were the nearest of her kindred.
translations.ron: Şi neamul lui Israel a jelit-o şapte zile. Şi înainte de moarte şi-a împărţit averea la rudele bărbatului ei Manase şi la rudele ei.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐπένθησεν αὐτὴν οἶκος Ἰσραὴλ ἡμέρας ἑπτά· καὶ διεῖλε τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτῆς πρὸ τοῦ ἀποθανεῖν αὐτὴν, πᾶσι τοῖς ἔγγιστα Μανασσῆ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς, καὶ τοῖς ἔγγιστα τοῦ γένους αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወእምድኅረ፡ እማንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ አተዉ፡ ኵሉ፡ ውስተ፡ ርስቱ፡ ወዮዲትኒ፡ አተወት፡ ቤጤልዋ፡ ወነበረት፡ ውስተ፡ ተግባራ፡ ወኮነት፡ ክብርተ፡ በመዋዕሊሃ፡ በኵሉ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: And there was none that made the children of Israel any more afraid in the days of Judith, nor a long time after her death.

translations.lxx: And there was none that made the children of Israel any more afraid in the days of Judith, nor a long time after her death.
translations.ron: Şi cât a trăit Iudita, nimeni n-a îndrăznit să tulbure pe Israeliţi şi încă multă vreme după moartea ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἔτι ὁ ἐκφοβῶν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἰουδὶθ, καὶ μετὰ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν αὐτὴν, ἡμέρας πολλάς.

verses.geez: ወብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ ይፈቅድዋ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘአእመራ፡ በኵሉ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሕይወታ፡ እምአመ፡ ሞተ፡ ምናሴ፡ ምታ፡ ወተቀብረ፡ ኀበ፡ ሕዝቡ።
ወዐብየት፡ ፈደፋደ።
ወረስዓት፡ በቤተ፡ ምናሴ፡ ምታ፡ ፻ወ
ወለሀውዋ፡ ቤተ፡ እስራኤል፡ ሰቡዓ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ወከፈለት፡ ንዋያ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ትሙት፡ ለኵሉ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ምናሴ፡ ምታ፡ ወለቅሩበ፡ አዝማዲሃ።
ወአልቦ፡ እንከ፡ ዘገረሞሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ እሥራኤል፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ዮዲት፡ ወዓዲ፡ እምድኅረ፡ ሞተት፡ ብዙኃ፡ መዋዕለ።
